name: io.github.GriffMurder/taskbullet
title: TaskBullet
description: Place US/CA phone calls and delegate tasks an AI agent cannot finish.

environmentVariables.name: TASKBULLET_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: TaskBullet API key (tb_live_...). Create it at https://taskbullet.com/dashboard/settings/api-keys. Shown once.

environmentVariables.name: TASKBULLET_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the Agent API base URL. Defaults to https://taskbullet.com/api/v1.

environmentVariables.name: TASKBULLET_SOURCE_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Audit label stored with each delegated task. Defaults to mcp-client.

environmentVariables.name: TASKBULLET_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Set to http to serve streamable HTTP. Default is stdio.

environmentVariables.name: TASKBULLET_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: HTTP bind address. Default 127.0.0.1. Any other address requires TASKBULLET_HTTP_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: TASKBULLET_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for non-loopback HTTP. Not the TaskBullet API key.

environmentVariables.name: TASKBULLET_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Extra browser Origin values for HTTP mode, comma-separated.
